title: Core Utilities
summary: This module provides foundational utilities for the LangChain ecosystem, encompassing API management, security, callbacks, tracing, data handling, and general-purpose helper functions.

nodes.label: API & Security
nodes.title: API and Security Utilities
nodes.description: Handles API management (beta warnings, deprecation) and critical security features like SSRF protection for URL validation and HTTP client requests.

nodes.label: Callbacks & Tracing
nodes.title: Callbacks and Tracing
nodes.description: Provides core infrastructure for handling callbacks and tracing, enabling detailed monitoring and interaction with components during execution.

nodes.label: Data Handling
nodes.title: Data Handling Module
nodes.description: Offers core functionalities for loading, indexing, and storing documents and vectors, including in-memory implementations and LangSmith integration.

nodes.label: General Utilities
nodes.title: General Utilities
nodes.description: A collection of general-purpose utility functions and classes, including tools for asynchronous iteration, HTML parsing, Pydantic handling, and system information.

groups.label: Core Infrastructure
